purpose: Independently cross-check the frozen ROLO-311g lunar extraterrestrial source implementation against public SI-traceable Air-LUSI 2022 lunar spectral irradiance before any atmospheric moonlight or total-sky validation claim.

referenceDataset.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
referenceDataset.title: Air-LUSI - Lunar Spectral Irradiance Data Repository: 2022 Data
referenceDataset.knownDependencyBoundary: Air-LUSI TOA spectra are SI-traceable measurements, but the campaign processing used ROLO only to normalize relative lunar-irradiance change over each approximately 40-minute collection interval. Therefore this comparison is suitable for absolute/spectral cross-checking at the frozen reference times but is not represented as fully independent validation of ROLO short-timescale phase evolution.

auditedVariables.Irradiance: Air-LUSI observed irradiance corrected to TOA and standardized to observer-Moon distance 384400 km and Sun-Moon distance 1 AU; use issue #5 correction for conversion back to true distances.
auditedVariables.distance_correction_factor: Divide standardized Irradiance by this factor to recover TOA irradiance at the true observer-Moon and Sun-Moon separations.
auditedVariables.signed_phase: degrees; preserve sign as provenance and pass absolute geometric phase to the nonnegative ROLO phase argument.
auditedVariables.Lunar_Disk_Reflectance: Official Air-LUSI derived quantity explicitly identified by the notebook as compatible with ROLO/GIRO disk reflectance; it already removes the solar-spectrum scale in the documented Air-LUSI construction and is used directly in the no-external-solar-spectrum comparison arm.
auditedVariables.Wavelength: vacuum wavelength channel centroid in nm.

officialSolarSpectrum.family: TSIS-1 Hybrid Solar Reference Spectrum Version 2

upstreamKnownIssuesFrozenBeforeNumericCo.title: Error in metadata for irradiance
upstreamKnownIssuesFrozenBeforeNumericCo.rule: Follow the repository notebook/maintainer correction: where a conversion from the dataset's distance-normalized Irradiance to true observer-Moon and Sun-Moon separations is required, divide by distance_correction_factor; never multiply because the Irradiance variable description contains the acknowledged metadata error.

upstreamKnownIssuesFrozenBeforeNumericCo.title: Lunar Zenith angle discrepancy
upstreamKnownIssuesFrozenBeforeNumericCo.rule: Do not use the dataset lunar zenith angle as evidence about the ROLO extraterrestrial source. Preserve the reported approximately 0.46-0.57 degree geometry discrepancy and the maintainer statement that its atmospheric-absorption impact is below assigned uncertainty. Any later atmospheric-scattering validation must resolve/freeze its own lunar geometry independently.

sourceAdmission.qualityExclusions: Only dataset-authored quality/validity flags or nonfinite/missing reference values may exclude a wavelength/case; every exclusion and reason must be reported.
sourceAdmission.phaseConvention: Preserve the dataset signed phase convention as provenance; pass the absolute geometric phase angle to the frozen ROLO implementation, whose physical phase argument is nonnegative.
sourceAdmission.geometry: Use dataset-provided phase/libration/subsolar geometry and distance metadata only after semantic audit against the official Air-LUSI example notebook and open-issue corrections. Do not infer geometry from agreement with the model.
sourceAdmission.solarSpectrum: For the full irradiance arm, bind the exact TSIS-1 HSRS v2 0.1-nm/0.025-nm-sampling artifact named by the frozen official notebook and its byte SHA-256 before reading model/reference irradiance residuals. No alternative solar spectrum may be chosen from agreement.

armA_diskReflectanceDirect.modelQuantity: ROLO Eq.10 disk-equivalent reflectance at original published ROLO effective wavelengths
armA_diskReflectanceDirect.wavelengthMapping: For each original frozen ROLO effective wavelength inside both 380-780 nm and the closed Air-LUSI Wavelength centroid range, linearly interpolate the Air-LUSI Lunar_Disk_Reflectance only between the immediately bracketing Air-LUSI channel centroids. No extrapolation, smoothing, scale fit or spectral tilt fit.
armA_diskReflectanceDirect.reason: The official NIST notebook explicitly identifies Lunar_Disk_Reflectance as the quantity compatible with ROLO/GIRO. This arm therefore checks the frozen Eq.10 coefficient/geometry implementation without introducing a separately downloaded solar spectrum or distance conversion.
armA_diskReflectanceDirect.claimLimit: Does not validate Eq.7 distance scaling, Eq.8 irradiance conversion, the research-only between-band reconstruction, atmospheric scattering or total sky.

armB_fullToaIrradiance.distanceCorrectionRule: Use standardized Irradiance directly when comparing at the ROLO standard distances; if comparing at each flight's true distances, divide by distance_correction_factor and use the dataset d_observer_moon and d_sun_moon in the frozen model. Never mix these two distance conventions in one residual.
armB_fullToaIrradiance.primaryBandNodeComparison: Evaluate predicted lunar irradiance at every original frozen ROLO effective wavelength admitted by the common spectral range, using no between-band interpolation for the lunar reflectance term.
armB_fullToaIrradiance.secondaryContinuousSpectrumComparison: Evaluate the research-only log-reflectance interpolation on the Air-LUSI wavelength grid only after the original-band-node comparison; report it separately and never call it operational ROLO/GIRO.

comparisonPlan.thresholdPolicy: No acceptance threshold is invented in v1. These are descriptive independent cross-checks. A later pass/fail gate, if scientifically needed, must be frozen from primary-source uncertainty/capability requirements before inspecting model-reference residuals.

claimBoundary.permittedClaim: Once executed under this frozen contract, the result may be reported only as an independent SI-traceable TOA lunar-source reflectance/irradiance cross-check with the Air-LUSI within-flight ROLO normalization dependency disclosed.

gateLogic.diskReflectance: Requires exact Air-LUSI binary SHA-256 verification plus the already-frozen official-notebook semantic audit; no external solar-spectrum artifact is required.
gateLogic.irradiance: Requires every disk-reflectance prerequisite plus exact TSIS-1 HSRS v2 artifact SHA-256 binding and explicit standard-distance versus true-distance mode selection before residual calculation.
